Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Defence, has released an official notification for the recruitment of Probationary Engineers in the E-II Grade. A total of 350 vacancies are available across Electronics and Mechanical disciplines. Eligible engineering graduates can submit their online applications through the official BEL careers portal.

Notification Overview

  • Issuing Authority: Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)
  • Notification / Advertisement Number: 17556/HR/All-India/2026
  • Total Vacancies: 350 (including backlog)
  • Designation: Probationary Engineer (E-II Grade)
  • Job Type: Central PSU

Vacancy Distribution and Posts

The recruitment drive covers two major engineering disciplines:

  • Probationary Engineer (Electronics): 200 posts
  • Probationary Engineer (Mechanical): 150 posts

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limit

Candidates must ensure they meet the specific academic and age requirements before applying:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold a 4-year B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering Degree or AMIE/AMIETE/GIETE in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-approved institution. Unreserved (UR), OBC (NCL), and EWS candidates require a First Class, while SC, ST, and PwBD candidates require a Pass Class.
  • Age Limit: The upper age limit is 25 years for UR/EWS candidates as on 01 October 2026. Age relaxations apply to reserved categories (OBC, SC, ST, PwBD, and ESM) as per government guidelines.

Application Fees and Important Dates

  • Application Fee: ₹1,180 for GEN/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, and ESM candidates are exempted from the fee.
  • Payment Mode: Online via SBI e-Pay Lite gateway.
  • Application Start Date: 28 October 2026 (02:00 PM)
  • Application Closing Date: 18 November 2026 (11:59 PM)
  • Tentative CBT Date: 22 December 2026

Selection Process

The selection procedure comprises a Computer-Based Test (CBT) carrying 85% weightage, followed by an interview carrying 15% weightage. The CBT will feature objective-type questions with a negative marking of 1/4th mark for every incorrect answer. Shortlisting for the interview will be done in a 1:5 ratio discipline-wise and category-wise.

Salary and Emoluments

Selected candidates will be placed in the basic pay scale of ₹40,000 - 3% - ₹1,40,000 (due for revision effective 01 January 2027), with an approximate annual CTC of ₹13 lakh. Additional benefits include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Conveyance Allowance, Performance Related Pay, Medical Reimbursement, and other perquisites.

How to Verify and Apply

Applicants should verify all details directly from the official notification available on the BEL careers portal at bel-india.in. No hard copies of the application need to be sent to BEL.
